name: How do you compare commercial project management firms?

mainEntity.name: How should you compare commercial project management companies for a Los Angeles project?
mainEntity.text: How should you compare commercial project management companies for a Los Angeles project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial project management firms should be compared on more than price. Relevant experience matters most, especially if the project is a tenant improvement, mixed-use buildout, office renovation, or occupied-building project. Owners should ask how the firm handles budgeting, schedule control, change orders, subcontractor coordination, and permit follow-up. It also helps to review sample reporting, meeting cadence, and escalation procedures. In a market like Los Angeles, local familiarity with permitting and city-specific workflows can be a major advantage. Owners should also evaluate responsiveness and clarity, because the project manager will be the communication hub for many stakeholders. The right firm should make complex decisions easier, not add another layer of confusion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare firms by relevant project type, local permitting experience, communication style, reporting process, fee structure, and ability to coordinate occupied-site work. The strongest firm is usually the one that has handled similar scope, not just the lowest price or biggest brand name.
